Name: Raised Bed Cedar Planter 5-Level Triolife Plant Pyramid, Pots & Planters, by Infinite Cedar
Natural: The Plant Pyramid 5-Level Planter is designed to increase the growing and harvest potential from small spaces, but dont let that stop you from putting one in your spacious yard! This planter can allow you to grow over 7 times more plants per square foot without the aches and pains of kneeling and bending. The Plant Pyramid 5-level Planter can support 7 times more plants per square foot than a similar size standard planter. It covers only 6.5 sq. ft. of ground space, but offers 36 sq. ft. of space for planting. The stacked beds allow root systems to take advantage of a large soil volume and promote more vigorous plant growth. By raising the garden beds off the ground, they are easy to reach for planting, tending and harvesting and at a height thats pleasing to the eye and sure to catch the attention of your neighbors and friends. The pyramid planter enables gardeners with limited planting space to grow vegetables and herbs, so you can shop for dinner right in your backyard. And you can also grow flowers to provide the centerpiece for your yard as well.
